metadata.title: On divisible domains of the flat affine space with parallel volume
metadata.abstract: We consider a domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ divisible by a discrete subgroup $\Gamma$ of the unimodular affine group $\operatorname{SL}_d(\mathbb{R})\ltimes\mathbb{R}^d$. We prove that $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^d$ if $\Gamma$ is virtually solvable or if its linear holonomy is virtually contained in a semisimple Lie subgroup of real rank one. In particular, we establish the Kleinian Markus conjecture in both cases.
